verdict.rationale: The only team-level API evidence is a developer blog entry on listing the contents of all team-accessible namespaces, which implies team-scoped API access, plus general OAuth scope customization. Nothing in the pack documents member provisioning, group management, or admin endpoints for automation. missing for 10: documented member provisioning/deprovisioning endpoints, group management API, admin/team-management endpoint reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of team automation.
